title: Charming 4BR Rosemary Beach, FL Home with a Private Pool
meta_description: Relax at Rosemary Bluegrass, a 4BR, 4BA Rosemary Beach home, walking distance to the beaches and premium amenities, with a private pool. sleeps 12.
description_expanded: DescriptionWhat Guests Love• Private courtyard pool (Pool heat may be added for $45/day plus tax)• Fully-equipped outdoor kitchen featuring gas grill, ice maker, refrigerator, and sink• Spacious outdoor dining and lounge areas• Outdoor shower• Complimentary beach cruiser bicycles (4)• Balcony seating and dining spaces• Four private community pools• Washer & dryer• TVs in all rooms• Complete Clean Bedding Program• Starter amenities: toilet paper, paper towels, dishwasher & laundry pods• Parking available for up to two vehicles.Welcome to Rosemary Bluegrass, a charming rustic-chic courtyard home nestled in the heart of historic Rosemary Beach. Perfectly positioned within easy walking distance of pristine beaches, premium amenities, renowned restaurants, and upscale shopping, this luxurious retreat embodies effortless coastal elegance. With its private courtyard and heated splash pool, beautiful wooden beams, vaulted ceilings, and thoughtfully curated décor, Rosemary Bluegrass transports guests to a serene Caribbean-inspired haven along Florida’s scenic 30A.Boasting four spacious bedrooms, each with private ensuite bathrooms—including two king bedrooms on the first floor, a king suite with balcony on the second, and an expansive bunk room on the third—this home comfortably accommodates multigenerational families and groups. The inviting open-concept kitchen, dining, and living areas seamlessly blend luxury and comfort, ideal for both relaxation and entertaining.Rosemary Beach offers unparalleled community amenities, including four inviting pools conveniently located throughout the neighborhood and exclusive private beach access just three houses away at Hope Town Lane. Explore nearby boutiques and exceptional dining experiences, or enjoy the local farmers market every Sunday in Barrett Square from 9 am to 1 pm. For those seeking recreation, Rosemary Beach provides access to public tennis courts and fitness facilities (additional fees apply).Whether your ideal vacation includes lounging by the emerald Gulf waters, leisurely bike rides, boutique shopping, playing tennis, or simply unwinding on a peaceful balcony, Rosemary Beach presents endless opportunities for cherished memories.Accommodations:• Bedroom 1: King bed, ensuite bath (1st Floor)• Bedroom 2: King bed, ensuite bath (1st Floor)• Bedroom 3: King bed, ensuite bath, balcony access (2nd Floor)• Bedroom 4: Bunk room with Full/Full and Twin/Twin bunks, ensuite bath (3rd Floor)TDT-085656
